contract.purpose: Expose read-only RTK savings telemetry to the MAGRA web dashboard.
contract.scope: Provide `/api/rtk/savings` session-delta snapshots, hide raw RTK output, and keep dashboard polling separate from chat/tool execution.

invariants.invariant-2: Raw `rtk gain` output never crosses the dashboard API boundary.
invariants.invariant-3: Session savings are deltas from a server-lifetime baseline.
